summary: Iteration 59: Kuaishou-style Nested Feed - ALL TESTS PASSED. Verified new ReelsPage.jsx with two modes: 'global' (vertical scroll) and 'vendor' (82%/18% split with side thumbnails). Backend APIs /reels-feed and /group-products working correctly. No regressions on Homepage, Products page.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Reels page /reels loads in global mode with data-testid='reels-page' and data-testid='global-feed'
VERIFIED: Each reel card shows product image, name, price, Like/Cart/Share buttons and Store button
VERIFIED: Clicking Store button (data-testid='reel-vendor-{id}') enters vendor mode
VERIFIED: In vendor mode: main content shrinks (~82%), side panel appears (data-testid='vendor-side-panel') at ~18%
VERIFIED: Side panel shows small thumbnail cards (data-testid='vendor-thumb-{id}') in vertical scroll
VERIFIED: Works count badge visible (data-testid='vendor-works-count') - shows 'Works 11' for Co-ord Set
VERIFIED: Vendor feed (data-testid='vendor-feed') shows only products from same vendor/category
VERIFIED: Back button in vendor mode exits to global mode (does not navigate away)
VERIFIED: Title changes from 'Explore' to vendor/category label (e.g., 'CO-ORD SET', 'JACKETS') in vendor mode
VERIFIED: 'Swipe right to go back' hint visible in vendor mode
VERIFIED: 'Swipe left for more from seller' hint visible in global mode
VERIFIED: Cart functionality works - 'Added to cart' toast appears, cart badge updates
VERIFIED: Like functionality works (localStorage-based)
VERIFIED: Clicking thumbnail in side panel scrolls vendor feed to that product
VERIFIED: Mobile view works - side panel respects max-w-[100px] (measured 70px)
VERIFIED: Desktop view works - side panel respects max-w-[160px]
VERIFIED: Smooth animations on mode transitions (framer-motion AnimatePresence)
VERIFIED: Backend /api/vendor-credits/reels-feed returns products with is_boosted flag
VERIFIED: Backend /api/vendor-credits/group-products returns grouped products by category or vendor_id
VERIFIED: Co-ord Set category has 11 products - best for testing multi-thumbnail panel
REGRESSION PASS: Homepage (/) loads with hero, Featured Sellers, New Arrivals sections
REGRESSION PASS: /products page loads with 26 products and filters
REGRESSION PASS: Product page loads correctly with all details
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kuaishou-style nested feed implemented in ReelsPage.jsx. Two modes: 'global' (normal vertical scroll with Store buttons) and 'vendor' (82%/18% split with side thumbnail panel). Store button click or swipe LEFT enters vendor mode. Back button or swipe RIGHT exits vendor mode. Co-ord Set category has 11 products - best for testing multi-thumbnail panel. Side panel max-width: 100px mobile, 160px desktop. Razorpay payments and Instagram Auto-DMs are MOCKED.
